issues.description: Missing shebang and docstring. The file starts directly with 'from conan import ConanFile' without '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and a docstring describing the software name and build system (e.g., '"""Conan recipe — libconfig 1.7.3 (Autotools)"""').
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line, followed by a docstring: '"""Conan recipe — libconfig 1.7.3 (Autotools)"""' before the imports.

issues.description: Prohibited template placeholder: 'url = ""  # CI fills this'. The code style rule explicitly lists this pattern as an unfilled placeholder that must be resolved by the adapter before merge.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the recipe repository URL, e.g., url = "https://cnb.cool/ohos/ohos-third-party-archives" or the appropriate recipe repository URL. Remove the '# CI fills this' comment.

issues.description: URL has a manually added mirror prefix 'https://gh-proxy.com/' as the first entry. Rule R39 states that CI automatically adds mirror fallbacks (gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub) for GitHub URLs, so conandata.yml should only contain the official original URL without manual mirror prefixes.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the first URL entry with the gh-proxy prefix. Keep only the official URL: 'url: "https://github.com/hyperrealm/libconfig/releases/download/v1.7.3/libconfig-1.7.3.tar.gz"'. CI will add mirror fallbacks automatically.

issues.description: Missing 'name' field. The manifest.yaml code style standard requires a 'name' field (e.g., 'name: libconfig') as the first field, but the file starts directly with 'version: "1.7.3"'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'name: libconfig' as the first line of manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Template placeholder '$DEFAULT_PREFIX' in configure_options. The value '--prefix=$DEFAULT_PREFIX' is an unresolved shell variable placeholder that should not appear in committed metadata.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace with the actual install prefix used during build, or remove the configure_options entry if the prefix is handled by Conan's AutotoolsToolchain (which it is — the conanfile.py uses tc.generate() properly).

issues.description: patches_applied section has incorrect patch file names. It lists '0001-aux-build-config.guess.patch' and '0002-aux-build-config.sub.patch', but the actual patch files (per conandata.yml) are '0002-aux-build-config.guess.patch' and '0003-aux-build-config.sub.patch'. Additionally, patches 0001-ac_config.h.in.patch and 0004-configure.patch are missing from the list.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update patches_applied to match conandata.yml: list all 4 patches with correct names: '0001-ac_config.h.in.patch', '0002-aux-build-config.guess.patch', '0003-aux-build-config.sub.patch', '0004-configure.patch'.

issues.description: Hardcoded local machine paths in patch_generation section: 'source_orig_dir: /storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/libconfig-1.7.3.orig' and 'source_work_dir: /storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/libconfig-1.7.3.work'. These are local build paths that should not be committed to the repository.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the source_orig_dir and source_work_dir fields from manifest.yaml, or replace with relative paths. The patch_generation metadata can keep method, hashes, and timestamps without leaking local paths.

issues.description: Empty requirements() method with just 'pass'. If the package has no dependencies, the method is unnecessary and can be removed. While not a 'pass # TODO: implement' pattern, it adds dead code.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the requirements() method entirely since the package has no dependencies. Conan handles the absence gracefully.

issues.description: Unused import 'os'. The 'import os' statement is only referenced in a commented-out line (line 34: '# self.run(f"{os.path.join(...)}"...)'). Since the active code uses cmake.test(), the import is effectively dead code.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import os' if the commented-out alternative code is not needed, or uncomment and use the direct binary execution approach.

issues.description: Unfilled template placeholders '（待填写）' in the conversation log section. Lines 50-51 have '**结果**: （待填写）' and '**发现的问题**: （待填写）'. The status table at line 12 also shows all options instead of selecting one.
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill in the conversation log with actual results and findings from the build process. Update the status table to show the actual status (e.g., '✅ success' instead of all options).

issues.description: All patch_classification entries have 'guard: pending' which appears to be unfilled metadata. All 4 patches (lines 39, 43, 47, 51) have this status.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the 'guard' field for each patch to reflect the actual guard status (e.g., 'none' if no guard is needed, or the actual #ifdef guard used).

issues.description: Patch modifies 'configure', which is a generated file (produced by autoconf from configure.ac). Rule R6 prefers modifying source files over generated products. While using patches/ to apply the change is the correct mechanism, the underlying fix (umask 077→000) is in autoconf's template, not in configure.ac itself.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider whether the umask fix can be applied at the source level (e.g., via a sed command in generate() or by patching the autoconf macro that generates this template). If not practical, keep the patch but document why source-level fix is not feasible.

summary: Audit of libconfig 1.7.3 Conan recipe — VERDICT: PASS (no P0/P1 issues). Verified: (1) sha256 hash '545166d6cac037744381d1e9cc5a5405094e7bfad16a411699bcff40bbb31ee7' matches the actual downloaded tarball from GitHub — not fake. (2) test_package/test.c calls real libconfig API (config_init, config_read_string, config_lookup_string, config_lookup_int, config_destroy) — not an empty shell test (R34 PASS). (3) test_package/conanfile.py test() calls cmake.test() — not skipping tests (R9 PASS). (4) conanfile.py build() contains no shell variables or hardcoded paths (R33 PASS). (5) No settings.os == 'Linux' pattern — no R32 violation. (6) URL points to official hyperrealm/libconfig GitHub release (R39 source legitimacy PASS). (7) All 4 patches are properly declared in conandata.yml and exist as files. (8) No binary artifacts, no fake status. Found 7 P2 warnings (missing shebang/docstring, url placeholder, manual mirror prefix, missing name in manifest, $DEFAULT_PREFIX placeholder, incorrect patches_applied list, hardcoded local paths) and 5 P3 hints (empty requirements(), unused import os, unfilled notes.md template, pending guard metadata, generated file patch). These are non-blocking warnings.
